description: The two joins of a token's parts are independent (engine §5). An empty opaque part between two pauses gives `?` to the phonemes, so they keep both pauses. It gives nothing to the label, so there the pauses are adjacent, and the label keeps only the first. Both joins find a pause part by its phonemes, so the label keeps the text `-` of the first pause.
grammar:
%rule text $w(word)
%emits $w <W>
%rule word L P gap P L
%rule gap ε
%opaque
